Neither option matches the physiology: complete phosphocreatine resynthesis after very high-intensity exercise normally takes about 3–5 minutes (some sources say up to about 8), with half restored in roughly 20–30 seconds. If you must choose between the two, 30 minutes is closer, but it is still far off, so I'd check the source of the team note before relying on it.

CONFIDENCE: 75
